thread:
ada (DevEx): Quick heads-up: planning to publish SDK py/ts 0.13.0 in tonight's 23:00 UTC change window. Main items: async improvements, soft-deprecate old auth shim. Any red flags?

ben (Release): Checklist: canary smoke, signature/fingerprint match, docs staged. If we see any pub errors (403 or signer mismatch) we DO NOT flip dist-tags and follow rollback runbook.

carl (QA): canaries started. Early result: npm publish passed, pip wheel upload succeeded but verifier flagged fingerprint mismatch for wheel on runner-9.

publish-bot: ci-publish-1756661200: upload complete; signature check failed. expected=SHA256:AA11...BB, observed=SHA256:EE33...FF. Action: HOLD.

ben (Release): Hold flip. Do not update npm 'latest' or PyPI index metadata. Ben -> infra/security: check HSM mappings on runner-9.

ada (DevEx): @publish-bot paste non-secret verifier output and runner id. We'll republish from verified runner once keys confirmed.

publish-bot: verifier output: runner=release-runner-9; expected_key_id=release-key-02; observed_key_id=staging-key-77.

carl (QA): looks like runner-9 pulled staging signer after deploy. I can re-run hermetic publish from release-runner-1 which we audited.

publish-bot: queued: ci-republish-1756661500 (runner=release-runner-1).

publish-bot: ci-republish-1756661500: uploads + verifications succeeded.

ben (Release): All gates met. Proceeding to flip dist-tags in 5m: npm 'latest' -> 0.13.0; npm 'legacy' -> 0.12.x. PyPI metadata will mark 0.13.0 as newest.

maya (Docs): Drafted release notes + deprecation banner; adding note about the temporary hold for transparency.

ada (DevEx): thanks. Closing thread after flip and 30m monitoring.
